english_evidence: Aggregator structured language field lists only 'Taal: Nederlands'; official Dutch-only website (rijschoolsignaal.nl) has no English content or English-lesson offer.
notes: Trades as 'Signaal Rijopleidingen'. Offers car (B), motorcycle (A/A1/A2/AM), and trailer (BE) categories; rijschoolspecialist confirms both manual ('Auto') and automatic ('Rijles met automaat') car lessons available. Founding: official website claims 'meer dan 35 jaar ervaring' (=> ~1991); clickdrive/Trustoo list '34 jaar ervaring' and 'meer dan 30 jaar' — conflicting/rounded experience claims, so founding_year is an experience-based estimate (med confidence), NOT explicit 'sinds YYYY'. Note KvK number 55398596 (8-digit, 55.xx range registered ~2012) post-dates the 35-yr experience claim, suggesting an entity re-registration; original operation is older. Ratings vary by platform: 4.7/5 (14 reviews, Google via clickdrive), 8.9/10 (16 reviews, Trustoo). CBR Den Bosch: 56% first-time pass (16 first exams), 78% reexam. Reviews mention instructor 'Corina' as warm/clear; one 1-star review about unkept appointments. No price published (tariff sites show 'Onbekend'); regional Vught hourly rate context ~EUR45-65. No English-instruction evidence found.
